title: "How to cite ENEM"

## General citation

::: {.cita}
Beltrán, Ulises, Rodrigo Castro Cornejo, Melina Altamirano, and Matthew Singer (2024), Mexican Election Study (UMASS-CSES) 2024, Lowell: Center for Public Opinion / University of Massachusetts Lowell.
:::

## Citation by year

::: {.cita}
Beltrán, Ulises (1997), Mexican Election Study (CIDE-CSES) 1997, Mexico City: Centro de Investigación y Docencia Económicas.
:::

### 2000 {#cite-2000}

::: {.cita}

:::
